text: 股市资金流向图：今日沪深两市主力资金净流出838.86亿元，占比3.49%；大单资金净流出409.39亿元，占比1.7%；小单资金净流入670.88亿元，占比2.79%。
text_en: Stock market capital flow map: Today, main capital in Shanghai and Shenzhen两市 net outflow was 83.886 billion yuan, accounting for 3.49%; large order capital net outflow was 40.939 billion yuan, accounting for 1.7%; small order capital net inflow was 67.088 billion yuan, accounting for 2.79%.
